News.Title: Steadier auctions and dice
News.Line1: With Dice So Nice on, Dragon's Teeth now shows the faces and the total the moment the 3D roll ends and lands a frame later, as it does without Dice So Nice. Before, the window coloured the dice and landed in the same instant.
News.Line2: When the GM running the game leaves and another GM takes over during an auction, the new GM's Foundry now brings the gavel down and runs the house bidders. Before, the auction waited for the next bid or a reload, and the gavel never fell.
News.Line3: A name that is missing, such as a deleted character's, now reads as nothing instead of the word "undefined" in the module's messages, in English and in a translation.

Welcome.Title: Loot Crates
Welcome.Heading: Welcome to Loot Crates
Welcome.NewsFoot: Shown once for each update. Don't show again turns these notes off; Show the welcome, in Game Settings under Loot Crates, brings them back.
Welcome.Lede: Build pools of items, price crates and games that draw from them, and let players buy a pull with their character's coins while the whole table watches it open.
Welcome.WhereShop: {crates}, at the top of the Items sidebar: the shop, for everyone.
Welcome.WhereManager: {manage}, beside it: pools, games and the pull log, for you alone.
Welcome.Step1: Press Add starter crates for a ready set, or New pool in the manager and drag items onto it.
Welcome.Step2: Look the games over on the Boxes tab, then press On the shelf on each one players may buy.
Welcome.Step3: Tell the table where Crates is. The shop starts open; Shop open, beside View shop in the manager, closes it when you want a pause.
Welcome.Foot: This opens once. After an update you get a short note of what changed; Don't show again turns that off too. Show the welcome, in Game Settings under Loot Crates, brings it back. Version {version}.
Welcome.MenuHint: Where the shop and the manager are, and the first steps. Closing it turns the short notes after each update back on.
